plugins.name: rationale-toolkit
plugins.description: Rationale-first coding style and outcome-verification discipline: explain the why before the what, and prove changes work before calling them done. Ships an optional ELI15 output style for plain-language explanations that always state what changed and what the user must do next, and a hook that blocks direct node_modules/.bin/ invocations.

plugins.name: dev-env-router
plugins.description: Directory-derived identity for local dev environments via Docker Compose + a single shared Traefik router: no manual port bookkeeping across projects and worktrees.

plugins.name: env-tiers
plugins.description: Three local environment tiers (worktree dev -> UAT -> prod) whose identity is derived from the directory name, so a wrong tier fails loudly instead of silently running the wrong config. Ships a command-entrypoint template and a prod guard hook that hard-blocks the irreversible commands.

plugins.name: mise-toolchain
plugins.description: Project toolchain versions and cross-worktree env layering via mise: inherit the machine's own version preferences into mise.toml, and share one baseline .env across worktrees without copying secrets around.

plugins.name: dev-credentials
plugins.description: A single machine-level file holding budget-capped dev credentials that an agent is explicitly allowed to read and use for testing, so real project secrets never have to be exposed to get a test run working.

plugins.name: plane-taskgraph
plugins.description: Turn design conversations into a structured task graph in Plane: functional areas become Modules, ordering becomes blocked_by relations, risk becomes a risk:* Label that decides when the agent pauses, and every finished item carries a verification record with git-generated changed files.

plugins.name: typesafe-jev
plugins.description: Design guidance for building with Jev, TypeSafe's typed-judgment model: when a task is Jev-shaped, how to word questions, batch calls, compose Jev with code, LLMs and people, pick thresholds, and fail safely. API fields are always read from TypeSafe's live docs.

plugins.name: emil-design-skills
plugins.description: Polished interface design, animation, motion review, and frontend tooling skills by Emil Kowalski.
